rules.title: Check tenant scoping on direct database access
rules.why: This team requires all tenant-owned queries to be scoped through the authenticated tenant. Direct access needs explicit verification.
verify: Identify the tenant predicate or tenant-scoped client used by this query.
Run a cross-tenant access test with a valid user and a different tenant's resource ID.

rules.title: Payment totals must come from server-owned data
rules.why: The client may request an order, but it must not choose the amount that is charged.
verify: Send a smaller client amount and confirm the server ignores it or rejects the request.
Verify the authoritative total includes server-side discounts, tax, and currency rounding.
